site: Henesys.gg item database (https://henesys.gg/loot), MapleStory Classic World
method: manual reading in a normal browser (T3 preview tab): the page loads its item list once, and its own search box filters that list in the page. Each Maple Island drop-list item was typed into the search box and the matching rows were read (0 network requests to the site during the reads). Only the rows for these items are kept.
scope: every item on MeowDB's community drop lists ('Drops (MS Classic)') of the 6 Maple Island monsters (tools/meowdb/captures/monster_*) and the Wooden Box (breakable_0000001.txt)
